name: Ensemble Methods

concepts.concept: Why ensembles work and their limits
concepts.summary: Averaging/voting reduces error only when member errors are imperfectly correlated; no guarantee to beat best member; shared bias survives.

concepts.concept: Random forests: random feature subset per split
concepts.summary: Considering m < p random candidates per split decorrelates trees; m = p reduces to bagging; tune m by validation.

sources.note: m = √p; m = p amounts to bagging; small m helps with many correlated predictors, p.353-354

concepts.concept: Ensemble failure modes: leakage, boosting overfit, regime shift
concepts.summary: Averaging cannot repair look-ahead leakage; boosting overfits as trees grow (early stopping); correlated members fail together in regime shifts.
